quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk hitting oncoming traffic head-on. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: Your car is in an accident and is blocking traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Move your car off the road if you can.
Do not move your car under any circumstances.
Wait for the police to arrive before moving your car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your car off the road if you can.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your car off the road if possible. Do not leave the scene without identifying yourself and helping if needed.

questions.question: Your body removes approximately how much alcohol per hour?
questions.explanation: The average person's body removes about one drink per hour. Many things affect how impaired you become, including how much you drink, how fast you drink, your body weight, what you eat, and your health.

questions.question: When can you not cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with other traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car ahead of you has broken down.
When passing to the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with other traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do so safely without getting in the way of other traffic.

questions.question: A green arrow changes to a solid green light. What can you do?

options.text: You can still turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
You cannot turn and must go straight.
You still have the right to turn.
You do not have to turn in the direction the arrow pointed.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can still turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow turns into a solid green light, you can still turn in that direction. However, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first.

questions.question: What does a solid white line in the middle of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic goes in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic goes in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic goes in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic goes in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic goes in the same direction and you cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic going in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: For drivers 21 or older, what blood alcohol level (BAC) is illegal to drive with?
questions.explanation: For drivers 21 or older, driving with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal. Driving under the influence is dangerous and against the law.

questions.question: Two cars enter an intersection at the same time from different roads. Which car must let the other go?
questions.explanation: When two cars reach an intersection at the same time, the car on the left must yield to the car on the right. This applies whether the intersection has signs, signals, or neither.

questions.question: A bus is signaling to get back on the main road after a stop. What must you do?

options.text: Honk to show you see them.

questions.explanation: You must let any bus that is signaling to pull back onto the road after stopping. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to give the bus room to safely enter traffic.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of a driveway, or to make a U-turn where it is allowed.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The largest vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at the same time to an uncontrolled intersection, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The driver on the left may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to your current lane.
The lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your current lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to your current lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you move onto the exit ramp.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to complete a left turn. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to tell drivers to let you through.
Drive around the rear of a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another vehicle hits you from behind, this protects you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: It is legal to drive faster than the speed limit when passing another vehicle.
questions.explanation: You must never exceed the posted speed limit, even when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: When driving in fog, should you use your high beam headlights?
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights in fog. High beam headlights reflect off the fog and shine back into your eyes.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which direction should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle begins to straighten, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: What happens when you drink coffee after drinking alcohol?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It cancels the effect of the alcohol.
It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. While it may help you stay awake, it cannot change your blood alcohol level or make you sober.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect the distance needed to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change with speed and road conditions.

questions.question: Why is a leaky exhaust system dangerous?

options.text: It can cause carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can cause carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes gases from your vehicle and keeps fumes out of the passenger area. A leak lets carbon monoxide enter the car. Fix any leaks right away.

questions.question: What is the minimum safe following distance in normal driving conditions?
questions.explanation: The three-second rule helps you keep a safe distance from the car in front of you. This applies to normal-sized vehicles in normal driving conditions.

questions.question: What should you do when two railroad tracks are next to each other?

options.text: It is always safe to go after one train passes.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check for a train on the other track before going.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check for a train on the other track before going.
questions.explanation: When two tracks are side by side, watch for a second train after the first one passes. Do not cross until you know no train is coming from either direction on either track.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: Begin signaling as you move into the new lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets, or five seconds before on freeways.

questions.question: Why should drivers watch carefully for motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are smaller and harder to spot than cars. They also move faster and have less visible lights. Drivers must stay alert to avoid hitting them.

questions.question: What does a red and white triangular sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways as you cross.
Come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: This is a yield sign. Slow down as you approach the intersection and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Be ready to stop if you need to.

questions.question: What is important to do before turning left?

options.text: Move to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic gets a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic light, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.question: If you see both a red light and a green arrow, can you turn in the direction of the arrow?
questions.explanation: You can turn in the direction of a green arrow after you let traffic in the intersection pass. You do not need to wait for the red light to change.

questions.question: What must you do at a flashing red light?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through.
Turn right or left because the road is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop completely. Then proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: Do highways and roads freeze before ramps and bridges?
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges freeze before regular roads because they are in the air and get cold from both sides. Drive slowly and carefully on bridges in winter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: When turning left from a multilane, one-way street or highway, start from which lane?
questions.explanation: Start from the left lane when turning left on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed you can drive?

options.text: A speed that is faster than is reasonable and prudent.
A speed that is safe for existing conditions.

questions.explanation: You must not drive faster than is reasonable and prudent. Adjust your speed based on traffic, weather, pedestrians, road condition, and light. Always follow legal speed limits.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: May be ignored in rainy, snowy, or icy conditions.
Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Curve and turn signs often show a recommended speed for that area. You should follow this speed in fair weather. In rain, snow, or ice, drive even slower.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, it signals they plan to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line. What does this tell you?

options.text: You are on a two-way road.
You are on a one-way road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a two-way road.
questions.explanation: Yellow centerlines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Broken lines can be crossed to pass slower vehicles when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving past a parked car, what should you do?

options.text: Assume that the driver will open the car door as you approach.
Assume that the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume that the driver will open the car door as you approach.
questions.explanation: Assume the parked car's driver will open their door as you approach. Drive with extra caution near parked vehicles.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?
questions.explanation: Road condition greatly affects your stopping ability. Slow down when roads are slippery or poor to maintain control of your vehicle and avoid crashes.
